options.plugins: which plugins are on or off, if not as they come: {"memory": true, "tap-to-wake": false}
options.name: the assistant's name: its wake word, the page's title, what the LLM calls itself
options.language: en, es…: what it speaks and understands (default: the Mac's)
options.llm_model: the LLM's model (for Claude: sonnet, opus, haiku…)
options.mcp: .mcp.json with the MCP servers (default: your data folder's)
options.instructions: yours, added to the LLM's (text or a list of lines): who you are, how to talk…
options.detail: how much it says: concise, neutral, detailed or one of detail_levels
options.detail_levels: more levels, or other texts for these: {"name": "instruction for the prompt"}
options.ignore_others: the LLM stays quiet when what it hears is clearly not for it
options.tts: its voice engine: avspeech, macos… or none
options.voice: the voice (default: the language's); one, or one per language: {"es": "Mónica", "en": "Samantha"}
options.wake: the wake word engine: whisper, openwakeword… or none
options.wake_word: the word or model (default: its name)
options.threshold: how sure the wake word must be (each engine has its own default)
options.silence: seconds of silence that end a sentence
options.follow_up: seconds it keeps listening without its name after it last spoke or heard you
options.echo_guard: seconds without listening after speaking (its own echo)
options.tap_to_stop: tapping the screen stops it talking
options.fillers: «One moment, let me check» when a tool is slow
options.skills: time, date, timers, alarms, reminders, sums, units and volume, without the LLM
options.log_transcripts: write what it hears and says to the log (to debug); otherwise only lengths
options.mode: assistant, transcribe (only shows what it hears) or parrot (repeats it)
options.record: saves everything that arrives to a WAV (to debug)

packages: The Python packages of the plugins that are on (bin/anyassistant plugins requirements).
language: The one it speaks and understands (you can change it later by voice).
name: The assistant's name
Also its wake word: «Hey …».
llm: Claude needs Claude Code installed and signed in; Apple's, macOS 26 with Apple Intelligence.
models: Speech recognition, the wake word and voice detection: a few hundred MB the first time.
service: It runs in the background and comes back if it stops (launchd).
